changelog:
- Adds the `oo-alt-text-generator-ai` skill for using Alt Text Generator AI through an OOMOL-connected account.
- Provides the `generate_alt_text` action to create concise, accessibility-friendly alt text from a publicly reachable image URL.
- Uses the `oo` CLI connector flow so credentials are injected server-side and raw tokens are not handled directly.
- Documents schema inspection before each action run to ensure payloads match the live connector contract.
- Includes first-time setup and troubleshooting guidance for CLI installation, authentication, connection, and billing errors.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@46cfb3e`
summary: Alt Text Generator AI (alttextgeneratorai.com). Use this skill for ANY Alt Text Generator AI request — searching and reading data. Whenever a task involves Alt Text Generator AI, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
